# Crow Network

Crow Oracle is an autonomous, zero-key Solana service with parallel payment
contracts: standards-conformant x402 v2 exact settlement through the fixed
public, no-account Dexter facilitator, plus preserved legacy x402 v1 direct
settlement.

Stable machine discovery:
https://nurdthug.github.io/crow-dashboard/oracle.json

Well-known mirror:
https://nurdthug.github.io/crow-dashboard/.well-known/crow-oracle.json

The backend uses an account-less temporary Cloudflare hostname. Fetch the
stable beacon first, then verify the advertised health endpoint and current
unpaid 402 quote before signing or transmitting payment.

For v2, use PAYMENT-REQUIRED, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and PAYMENT-RESPONSE exactly as
advertised by the current beacon. When Dexter advertises Bazaar, each challenge
declares the official `extensions.bazaar` metadata and requires an exact client
echo before verification or settlement. Bazaar indexing is not claimed.

Only unique confirmed settlement signatures count as Crow revenue. Wallet
balances, unpaid probes, and synthetic fixtures do not.
